{{Quote|A Je'daii needs nothing but confidence and comfort in the Force. Clothes for warmth, a ship to travel in, food for energy, water to slake thirst, a sword to stab, a blaster to shoot&hellip; all these are luxuries. The Force is everything, and without it, we are nothing.|Shall Mar, 7,538 TYA|<ref name="DOTJ">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref>}}
The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''28,915 before the Battle of Yavin''', also known as '''7,538 after the Tho Yor Arrival''', was a year in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic history]]. That year, [[Je'daii Master]] [[Shall Mar]] spoke about a [[Je'daii Order|Je'daii's]] lack of need for comforts other than [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. His words were later collected in ''[[A Life in Balance]]''.<ref name="DOTJ" />
